attr.title: Endacopia
attr.desc: Endacopia is an unusual point-and-click puzzle adventure game. Help a boy named Mellow navigate a surreal, whimsical, and unsettling world filled with strange characters and creative puzzles.
attr.desc_md:
Endacopia is an unusual point-and-click puzzle adventure game created by Andyland. Help a lost child named Mellow navigate a surreal, whimsical, and unsettling world filled with strange characters and mind-bending puzzles.

This port runs natively on aarch64 using the Adventure Game Studio (AGS) engine with OpenGL ES 2 renderer acceleration.
attr.inst:
This port does NOT include the game. Copy Endacopia.ags, audio.vox and sp_speechsounds.vox from the Data folder of your own copy of Endacopia into ports/endacopia/.

On Steam those three files are in the Data folder, already loose, so nothing has to be extracted from the Windows executable.
